bestBets.overview: NOT TELLING raced up on the speed and held second spot at Gold Coast last start. This looks a winnable maiden and he is top pick. MISS VELCRO is a debutant who comes into this race off a Beaudesert trial win. Drawn to get all the favours from inside draw and if any stable support must follow. GOODFELLA FINCH led them up and held placing in maiden at Inverell last start before being overran last start. Looks the leader and the one to catch whilst DECOY was poor last start but she comes into this third-up and can sneak a placing.

raceTips.comment: Not Telling has come back nicely this prep and is hard fit after three runs. He beat all bar the winner on the Gold Coast last start, form which has stood up nicely given that winner Geitz, saluted next start in metro grade. That reads well for a race of this depth. Aces are Good debuts here but won’t have to be a star to win in his first start. Decent trial leading in and he gets an experienced rider on debut. Giving Shakdam a chance to hit back after a poor run on debut. She had trialled up well prior, winning a heat at Toowoomba. Divinelle was sound in a stronger race last start and she strips fitter.

bestBets.overview: DEEP TIARA is ready to win. She has been placed in both of her runs back from a spell at Toowoomba and only needs ythat form to get away with this. MISS DE MEDICI started favourite at Warwick last start but just found one better late and just missed. Third-up from spell and from inside barrier she should get her chance at some stage. ZARIPPA raced on the speed and just proved too smart at Warwick. He can go on with it here whilst FINAL VOYAGE just did not finish race off at Toowoomba last start but she had been racing well prior and can sneak a place.

raceTips.comment: Miss De Medici let down strongly at Warwick a week ago but just couldn’t reel in the winner on the line. She’s going to improve out of that and from barrier 1, she’ll likely settle just better than midfield and do no work in the run. With luck at the right time, she’ll be very hard to hold out. Straight Blast resumes here off a lovely trial on his home deck. He flashed good ability in his second prep and has more upside than the majority of these. Burleigh Magic may need the run off a spell but this is the weakest race he’s seen in some time. Deep Tiara best of the rest.

The lightly raced I Am Pietra won at a non-TAB meeting last start but she showed good improvement and should have more to come.

bestBets.overview: Tough race to finish the program. JEMELDI finished too well and won at Gatton last start. Finds a similar race and no reason he cannot win again. SAPANAS PEARL was placed at Gatton two starts back then faded late last start. She will sit in first couple and not without a chance in this. VESPER LYND was beaten less than 2 lengths at Toowoomba last start. She only needs to bring that form to be competitive in this while DUSAN comes off a last start placing at Roma and would not leave out of first four wagers.

raceTips.comment: It was a lovely ride on Jemeldi at Gatton, who was strong late to finish over the top of his rivals. This is only slightly tougher and he maps for a beautiful run in transit. He'll also get some weight relief from the apprentice claim. Sapana's Pearl will be near the pace from a good draw. Smaller chances given to Xerri and Vesper Lynd.
